bodyEn: Another European away day, another victory for Arsenal: albeit only just. This time, Viktor Gyökeres stole the show as poor Slavia Prague matched the longest winless streak in European Cup and Champions League history despite a spirited late comeback. That unwanted record stands at 23, equalling the mark set by AEK Athens and FCSB – formerly known as Steaua Bucharest – while Arsenal are unbeaten in their 10 last away trips.

However, had it not been for a wonder save from David Raya, the Czech champions would have snatched a point after Wiktor Nowak pulled one back late on as Mikel Arteta’s usually watertight defence showed signs of fallibility under pressure.
In contrast to last week’s defeat against Fleetwood in the Carabao Cup, Arsenal had been cruising until the last 15 minutes after Noni Madueke fired them ahead early on, set up superbly by Gyökeres.

That was the Sweden striker’s third assist in his past five appearances, although Arteta will have been even more encouraged by the emphatic finish that appeared to put the game beyond Slavia’s reach just before the break.

But the Arsenal manager admitted his side had taken their eye off the ball by allowing their hosts back into the game with some uncharacteristic defensive lapses as Slavia racked up 18 shots to his side’s 12.

“At half-time, the message was clear: there is still a lot to do in this game,” said Arteta. “We were extremely far from our standards in everything that we have to do, in every basic, in every concept and in everything that we discussed to avoid the game that we played in the second half. That is a huge learning.”

Slavia’s solitary victory in this competition came in their first-ever match in 2007 and after losing 3-0 to Arsenal here exactly a year ago, they knew their chances of avoiding the unwanted milestone were extremely slim. Arteta’s side have developed a killer instinct on their travels in Europe – not since May 2025 in the second leg of their semi-final against Paris Saint-Germain have Arsenal lost an away game in 90 minutes.

After their exploits at Anfield on Sunday that took them three points clear at the top of the Premier League, Arteta heavily rotated his side again with six changes. It’s perhaps not surprising that Martín Zubimendi ran out of steam given the Spain World Cup winner made only his third start of a so far frustrating campaign.

For the third time in Arsenal’s past four matches, Gyökeres was entrusted with leading the line after finally getting off the mark with a scrappy strike against Fleetwood. He finished as top scorer last season with 21 goals but has clearly been struggling for form and confidence. Yet there was no doubting the quality of his assist for Madueke’s opening goal after just eight minutes.

Raya’s long ball should have been dealt with by the Slavia defence but they made the criminal error of ­allowing it to bounce. That was the cue for Gyökeres to come alive as he beat his marker to the ball, chested it down and played the perfect pass for the England forward to run on to and score. Arteta’s reaction on the touchline suggested he enjoyed it too.

Mikel Merino was Arsenal’s hero here last year with two goals and he could have extended their lead on three occasions before the half-hour mark. The lively Madueke created his best opportunity after cutting the ball back to Merino but he could not beat Nazar Domchak in Slavia’s goal.

With Martin Ødegaard watching from the bench next to William Saliba on the latter’s return from a long-term back injury, Arsenal lacked some of their usual fluency in attack. But ­Slavia were still no match for them and their task became almost ­impossible seven minutes before the break. Gyökeres exchanged a smart one-two with Merino inside the area before curling a brilliant shot into the far corner.

To their credit, the hosts began the second half with much more aggression after introducing their record signing, Ange N’Guessan, from the bench. Ezri Konsa and Declan Rice both found themselves in the book as Arsenal were pinned back. David Jurasek let fly from long range and his effort was deflected just wide of Raya’s goal. From the resulting corner, Gabriel Magalhães somehow managed to clear two goalbound headers off the line in a matter of seconds. The Brazilian celebrated with a massive fist pump but his evening wasn’t over.

Mikulas Konecny should have done much better with another header before Raya managed to push Oskar Kubiak’s header on to the post despite being at full stretch in mid-air. Slavia eventually scored the goal all their endeavour deserved in the final minute of normal time when Nowak fired in at the far post. There were a few nervous moments in stoppage time as Konecny forced Raya into another save. Arteta breathed a sigh of relief at the full-time whistle as Slavia were condemned to their fate.

items.titleZh: 约克雷斯闪耀，阿森纳客场险胜布拉格斯拉维亚
items.summaryZh: 约克雷斯传射建功，阿森纳在欧冠客场艰难击败布拉格斯拉维亚。
bodyZh: 又是一个欧战客场，又是一场阿森纳的胜利：尽管赢得惊险。这一次，维克托·约克雷斯成为了全场焦点，可怜的布拉格斯拉维亚在经历了一次顽强的反扑后，追平了欧冠和欧战历史上最长的连续不胜纪录。
然而，要不是大卫·拉亚的神扑，在维克托·诺瓦克最后时刻扳回一城后，这位捷克冠军本可以抢走一分，米克尔·阿尔特塔那条平时固若金汤的防线在压力下显得漏洞百出。
与上周在联赛杯中输给弗利特伍德不同，自马杜埃凯开场不久破门后，阿森纳在最后15分钟之前一直顺风顺水，这粒进球由约克雷斯精彩助攻。
这是这位瑞典前锋在过去五次出场中的第三次助攻，不过在中场休息前锁定胜局的那记精彩进球，会让阿尔特塔感到更加鼓舞。
但这位阿森纳主帅承认，由于出现了罕见的防守失误，他们让对手重新看到了希望，阿尔特塔的球队全场被对手完成了18次射门，而他们自己只有12次。
“半场时，信息很明确：这场比赛还有很多工作要做，”阿尔特塔说。“我们在方方面面、在每一个基本功、每一个概念以及我们在赛前讨论的为了避免下半场那种局面的所有事情上，都远远没有达到我们的标准。这是一个巨大的教训。”
斯拉维亚在这项赛事中的唯一一场胜利还要追溯到2007年的队史首秀，而在整整一年前在这里以0-3输给阿森纳之后，他们知道自己避开这个不光彩里程碑的机会极其渺茫。阿尔特塔的球队在欧战客场已经培养出了杀手本能——自2025年5月对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的半决赛次回合以来，阿森纳在常规90分钟内的客场比赛中保持不败。
在周日对阵利物浦的比赛中消耗巨大并借此登上英超积分榜首之后，阿尔特塔再次对阵容进行了大幅轮换，做出了六处调整。马丁·祖比门迪在经历了一个目前为止令人沮丧的赛季后仅仅迎来了他的第三次首发，难怪他会感到体能耗尽，这或许并不令人意外。
在打破了对阵弗利特伍德的进球荒之后，约克雷斯在阿森纳最近四场比赛中第三次被委以重任领衔锋线。上赛季他以21个进球成为最佳射手，但本赛季显然一直在为状态和信心苦苦挣扎。然而，仅仅八分钟后，他为马杜埃凯首开纪录的那次助攻质量毋庸置疑。
拉亚的长传本应由斯拉维亚防线处理好，但他们犯下了致命错误，让皮球落地。这正是约克雷斯大显身手的信号，他抢在防守球员之前拿球，用胸部停球，并送出一记完美的传球，让这位英格兰前锋前插得分。阿尔特塔在场边的反应表明他也非常享受这个进球。
米克尔·梅里诺去年在这里打进两球堪称阿森纳的英雄，他在半小时前本有机会扩大领先优势。活跃的马杜埃凯在底线回传创造了最佳机会，但梅里诺未能攻破斯拉维亚门将纳扎尔·多姆恰克的十指关。

随着马丁·厄德高在替补席上观战，威廉·萨利巴也从长期背伤中复归，阿森纳在进攻中缺乏了以往的一些流畅度。但斯拉维亚仍然无法与他们匹敌，在中场休息前七分钟，客队的任务变得几乎不可完成。约克雷斯在禁区内与梅里诺完成了一次精妙的撞墙配合，随后将一记精彩的射门兜入远角。
平心而论，主队在下半场换上身披俱乐部引援纪录的球员安热·恩格桑后，带着更强的侵略性开局。埃兹里·孔萨和德克兰·赖斯双双吃牌，阿森纳被压制在半场。大卫·尤拉塞克远射，皮球折射后擦着拉亚的球门偏出。随后的角球中，加布里埃尔·马加良斯在几秒钟内不可思议地两次在门线前头球解围。这位巴西人挥舞着拳头疯狂庆祝，但他的夜晚还没结束。
米库拉斯·科内奇尼本该用另一个头球做得更好，随后拉亚在空中全力舒展，将奥斯卡·库比亚克的头球托到了立柱上。斯拉维亚最终在常规时间最后一分钟攻入了他们所有努力应得的进球，诺瓦克在后点包抄破门。伤停补时阶段出现了一些紧张时刻，科内奇尼迫使拉亚再次做出扑救。终场哨响时，阿尔特塔长舒了一口气，斯拉维亚则接受了他们的命运。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta is confident that William Saliba is ready to make his first appearance of the season for Arsenal after he played 45 minutes of a match behind closed doors last week.

The France defender started training on his own last month after the back injury he sustained at the World Cup but has since resumed full training and on Tuesday travelled with Arsenal’s squad to face Slavia Prague. It remains to be seen whether Saliba will feature in the Czech capital given such a lengthy absence, although Arteta insisted that he has no doubts the 25-year-old is primed to return.

Asked whether he would treat his comeback with caution, the Arsenal manager said: “Yes, but now you are in, or not. And now he’s in, and he’s in like anybody else. All the preparation has been done to measure all the loads and all the steps that he had to do to minimise that risk.

“Now he’s in a really good place. He’s built the capacity that we needed, and now it’s about giving him minutes. He’s a centre-back, and when that’s the case, it’s not like an attacking midfielder or a nine that you can change. A centre-back normally has to be able to play 90 minutes, and that’s why all the preparation that we’ve done to build him.”

Ezri Konsa and Gabriel Magalhães were outstanding in Arsenal’s landmark victory over Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday and Arteta admitted that Saliba’s return is likely to give him a selection headache. Konsa is also capable of playing at right-back, although he will face competition from Ben White and Jurriën Timber.

The latter escaped punishment against Liverpool when he pulled Alexander Isak’s shirt inside the penalty area and Arteta hit back at suggestions that officials could try to balance out that decision in future.

“I have a lot of clips about shirts, pulls, grabs. So I have a massive library that we can talk about,” Arteta said in an echo of his comments last month about straying outside his technical area. “We’re talking about one in particular. I have a massive library that we can throw there to remind everybody what every team is going through.”

Max Dowman is also in contention to play against Slavia as he serves a three-match domestic suspension for his red card against Fleetwood last week. He became the first 15-year-old to feature in the Champions League against the same opponents 12 months ago and could break Cesc Fàbregas’s record as the youngest Arsenal player to start in the competition.

“That’s a chapter that is gone. It’s a moment of learning from all of us, and we move on,” Arteta said of Dowman’s dismissal against Fleetwood. “He’s been engaged. Today we spent some time together, talking about things in training. He’s always super positive. When you’re 16 you have a different way of looking at things and treating things, and that’s what he brings to the team as well.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔支持萨利巴在对阵布拉格斯拉维亚时为阿森纳复出
items.summaryZh: 萨利巴伤愈随队出征，阿尔特塔称其已准备好复出。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔对威廉·萨利巴准备好迎来本赛季代表阿森纳的首次出场充满信心，此前他在上周的一场闭门比赛中踢了45分钟。
这位法国后卫在世界杯期间遭遇背部伤病后，于上个月开始单独训练，此后已恢复全队合练，并于周二随阿森纳大名单前往捷克面对布拉格斯拉维亚。鉴于缺阵时间如此之长，萨利巴是否会在捷克首都登场还有待观察，尽管阿尔特塔坚称他毫不怀疑这位25岁的球员已经做好了复出准备。
当被问及是否会谨慎对待他的复出时，阿森纳主帅说道：“是的，但现在你要么复出，要么不复出。现在他复出了，而且和其他人一样。所有的准备工作都已完成，以衡量他必须经历的所有负荷和步骤，从而将风险降至最低。”
“现在他的状态非常好。他已经建立起了我们所需的体能，现在关键是给他出场时间。他是一名中后卫，当情况如此时，它不像你可以替换的攻击型中场或9号球员。中后卫通常必须能够踢满90分钟，这就是我们为帮助他恢复而做所有准备工作的原因。”
埃兹里·孔萨和加布里埃尔·马加良斯在周日阿森纳客场战胜利物浦的里程碑式比赛中表现出色，阿尔特塔承认萨利巴的回归可能会让他面临幸福的烦恼。孔萨也能胜任右后卫，尽管他将面临本·怀特和尤里恩·廷贝尔的竞争。
后者在对阵利物浦时在禁区内拉扯亚历山大·伊萨克的球衣却逃脱了处罚，阿尔特塔对裁判可能在未来试图平衡这一判罚的说法进行了回击。
“我有很多关于球衣、拉扯和争抢的视频片段。所以我有一个庞大的资料库可以供我们讨论，”阿尔特塔回应了他上个月关于离开技术区的言论说道。“我们谈论的是其中特定的一次。我有一个庞大的资料库可以拿出来，提醒大家每个球队都在经历什么。”

items.titleEn: Andy Madley and VAR should take credit – they got major Anfield calls right | Chris Foy
items.summaryEn: Timber’s shirt pull on Isak was not a penalty on review, and Madueke’s clash with Mac Allister was clearly not violent conductThere was one incident that got everyone talking at the weekend, and that was the decision not to award Liverpool a penalty in their match against Arsenal after Alexander Isak had his shirt pulled by Jurriën Timber as he tried to get his head to a Bradley Barcola cross.The on-field decision from the referee, Andy Madley, was no penalty and it was a call backed by the video assistant referee, Stuart Attwell. bodyEn: There was one incident that got everyone talking at the weekend, and that was the decision not to award Liverpool a penalty in their match against Arsenal after Alexander Isak had his shirt pulled by Jurriën Timber as he tried to get his head to a Bradley Barcola cross.

The on-field decision from the referee, Andy Madley, was no penalty and it was a call backed by the video assistant referee, Stuart Attwell. After the match the Liverpool head coach, Andoni Iraola, said there had been a “clear, clear pull” and when the footage is slowed down or freeze‑framed, that looks to be true. But at full speed, the contact appears minimal and not sustained: Timber is using one hand and tugs briefly on the shirt, and the impact on Isak’s movement is arguable.

There is a high bar for penalising contact in the Premier League and that has to be taken into account by Attwell. Iraola said that he would encourage his players to go down in similar situations in future, but the incident was assessed by the VAR and didn’t clear the bar in his opinion on the day. For the VAR to overturn an on-field decision there needs to have been a “clear and obvious error” and that is not the case here in my view.

Later there was a great piece of refereeing from Madley that got approval from a lot of pundits, and I agree with them. The moment came in the 79th minute after a foul by Alexis Mac Allister on Martin Ødegaard. There is a coming together of a number of players and Noni Madueke squares up to Mac Allister. The pair’s heads touch with Mac Allister then falling to the ground as if seriously hurt. It’s always been the case that players look to ask a question of the referee. This was how it was when I was refereeing in the Premier League and it has not changed, with or without VAR. Here the question Madley had to answer was whether the contact by Madueke on Mac Allister added up to violent conduct. Clearly the answer to that was no. Madley gave a yellow card to Mac Allister but not to Madueke, who had been carded earlier, and the VAR did not intervene to recommend a review given there was no evidence of a missed red card. Madley deserves all the compliments he received for the way he handled it.

This was the busiest weekend of the season so far for VAR, with seven overturns across the first nine games. One intervention helps to draw a contrast with what happened, or did not happen, at Anfield, and that’s the decision to send off Jean-Philippe Mateta after VAR upgraded a yellow card to a red.

The situation followed a foul by the Crystal Palace striker early in their game against Tottenham. Mateta was trying to recover possession and tackled Micky van de Ven from behind. The Frenchman was awarded a yellow card by the referee, Michael Oliver, but when the VAR, Jarred Gillett, reviewed the footage he could see that not only was Mateta coming in from behind, he was well away from the ball and made full contact with his studs on Van de Ven’s achilles. Gillett recommended that Oliver go to the monitor to review his decision, which he did, sending Mateta off.

The VAR can initiate a review if he believes a “serious incident” has been missed by the referee. Here, Gillett was able to see what Oliver couldn’t: that Mateta’s challenge was a case of serious foul play which occurs when a player endangers the safety of an opponent or uses excessive force. The contact with Van de Ven’s achilles was clearly dangerous. It clears the high bar for intervention in a way that the pull on Isak did not. It was a good piece of work by Gillett and Oliver.

Elsewhere, VAR helped to achieve the correct outcome in a number of crucial events. An overturn in the Aston Villa v Fulham match rightly ended in Villa being awarded a penalty after the ball struck the arm of Sander Berge in an unnatural position. Chelsea were given a penalty against Manchester United after an aggressive challenge by Lisandro Martínez, who led with an arm, was initially missed on-field. Martínez was correctly handed a second yellow card, and a dismissal. At Stamford Bridge there were also two goals – one for each side – correctly overturned after they were assessed by the VAR using semi‑automated offside technology.

Coventry conceded a penalty in their 3-1 win against Sunderland after the VAR spotted a handball by Ethan Pinnock. Leeds had a goal overturned at Bournemouth after Dominic Calvert-Lewin was found to have handled the ball on its way into the net, which has to be disallowed even if accidental under the laws of the game.

That is a lot of activity at the Premier League’s VAR hub and the most notable thing was overall how quickly and smoothly it was dealt with by various sets of officials. Debate over the Isak decision may provide the main refereeing talking point before the next round of fixtures, but we should also take note when the system is working as it should.

items.titleZh: 安迪·马德利与VAR应记首功——他们在安菲尔德做出了正确的重大判罚
items.summaryZh: 专家克里斯·福伊认为安迪·马德利与VAR在安菲尔德球场的几次关键判罚准确无误。
bodyZh: 周末有一起事件成为了所有人讨论的焦点，那就是在阿森纳与利物浦的比赛中，亚历山大·伊萨克在试图接应布拉德利·巴尔科拉的传中时被尤里安·廷贝尔拉拽球衣，但裁判未判罚点球。
主裁判安迪·马德利的场上决定是不判点球，这一判罚得到了视频助理裁判斯图尔特·阿特韦尔的支持。赛后，利物浦主帅安多尼·伊劳拉表示这是一次“非常明显的拉拽”，当慢动作或定格回放时，这看起来似乎是真的。但在全速情况下，接触显得微乎其微且并不持续：廷贝尔只用了一只手短暂地拉扯了球衣，对伊萨克移动的影响是有争议的。
在英超联赛中，对身体接触的判罚标准很高，阿特韦尔必须将这一点考虑在内。伊劳拉表示他会鼓励自己的球员在未来类似情况下倒地，但在他看来，这一事件经过了VAR评估，并未达到介入的标准。对于VAR推翻场上判罚而言，需要出现“明显且清晰的错误”，但在我看来，这里并非如此。

随后，马德利做出了一次出色的裁判表现，得到了许多评论员的认可，我也赞同他们的看法。这一时刻发生在第79分钟，亚历西斯·麦卡利斯特对马丁·厄德高犯规之后。多名球员聚集在一起，农尼·马杜埃凯与麦卡利斯特对峙。两人的头部碰触，随后麦卡利斯特倒地，表现得像受了重伤一样。球员总是试图向裁判施压，无论有没有VAR，在我当年在英超执法时也是如此，情况从未改变。在这里，马德利需要回答的问题是，马杜埃凯对麦卡利斯特的接触是否构成了暴力行为。答案显然是否定的。马德利向麦卡利斯特出示了黄牌，但没有向此前已吃过牌的马杜埃凯出示黄牌，由于没有漏判红牌的证据，VAR也没有介入建议回看。马德利处理这一事件的方式赢得了所有的赞誉。
这是本赛季迄今为止VAR最忙碌的一个周末，前九场比赛中出现了七次改判。其中一次介入与安菲尔德发生或未发生的事情形成了鲜明对比，那就是在VAR将黄牌升级为红牌后，让让-菲利普·马特塔被罚下场的决定。
这一情况源于这位水晶宫前锋在对阵托特纳姆热刺比赛初期的犯规。马特塔试图重新争夺球权，从背后对米基·范德芬进行了铲球。主裁判迈克尔·奥利弗向这名法国球员出示了黄牌，但当VAR贾里德·吉利特回看录像时，他发现马特塔不仅是从背后冲撞，而且远离了球权，鞋钉完全踩到了范德芬的跟腱上。吉利特建议奥利弗去场边监视器重新查看判罚，奥利弗照做了，并将马特塔罚下。
如果VAR认为裁判漏掉了“严重事件”，他可以发起回看。在这里，吉利特看到了奥利弗没有看到的情况：马特塔的拼抢属于严重犯规，即球员危及对手安全或使用过分力量。对范德芬跟腱的接触显然是危险的。它以伊萨克被拉拽所没有的方式达到了介入的高标准。吉利特和奥利弗完成了一次出色的工作。
在其他赛场上，VAR在多次关键事件中帮助做出了正确的结果。维拉对阵富勒姆的比赛中的一次改判正确地判定维拉获得点球，因为皮球击中了桑德尔·贝格处于不自然位置的手臂。在切尔西对阵曼联的比赛中，由于利桑德罗·马丁内斯用手臂主导的侵略性拼抢在场上被漏判，切尔西获得了点球。马丁内斯被正确地出示第二张黄牌并罚下。在斯坦福桥，还有两粒进球——双方各一粒——在通过半自动越位技术进行评估后被正确取消。

bodyEn: Liverpool did not have a shot on target in their 1-0 defeat by Arsenal on Sunday, according to Opta, the first time they have drawn this type of blank in a Premier League game at Anfield since records began in 2003-04. They did not find the target in a goalless draw at the Emirates Stadium this year either, though in both games they struck the woodwork. The margins tend to be fine when recording statistical outliers.

If Alexis Mac Allister’s floated ball from distance into David Raya’s waiting arms had actually counted as a shot, would Andoni Iraola’s side have delivered a markedly better attacking performance? Far more concerning for the Spaniard will be that his team had 52 touches in the Arsenal penalty area (which is good) to create only one Opta‑defined big chance (which is bad). The Premier League average this season is five times more efficient; 10.3 box touches per big chance.

Credit to Arsenal for restricting the quality of Liverpool’s chances despite them getting repeatedly within range of their goal. Most teams have been able to do this, though. While 12 teams have had fewer touches in opposition penalty boxes than Liverpool, only Coventry with 11 have generated fewer big chances this season than Liverpool’s 12. Everton’s Thierno Barry alone has had 15, while Manchester City’s Erling Haaland has also had more than Liverpool with 14.

Liverpool have not had this issue in Europe. They have 12 big chances in the Champions League in just three games. As two of their opponents, Lask and Villarreal, are rated by Opta as being of lower standard than any side in the Premier League, this is little surprise. The relatively low stakes of a given match in the league- phase of the Champions League encourages those matches to be more open, too.

This has not been the case in the 2026-27 Premier League for Liverpool, who have spent more time building up against low defensive blocks than any other team. This is, in part, a problem of their own making as they have conceded first in five of their eight matches. Only against Ipswich and Brighton have they held two‑goal leads, meaning opponents have rarely had compelling need to significantly loosen their defensive grip.

In his first Liverpool press conference, head coach Iraola spoke of embracing the challenge set by deep-lying defences. “I prefer to face low blocks in terms of: ‘OK, we will be in control of the game, probably we will concede less chances, we will spend a lot of time in the opposition half and those are the scenarios that we have to find,’” he said. Only four teams have had more touches in the opposition half or attempted more final‑third passes than Liverpool this season, but such dominance has not led to higher value chances.

This is where Florian Wirtz should be making an impression. He has the ability to unpick the tightest of backlines. Yet he has not created a big chance in the league this season. If his low total of five in his debut campaign was understandable with the problems Liverpool faced on-and-off the pitch, he trailed distantly behind Dominik Szoboszlai (14), Mohamed Salah (11) and Cody Gakpo (10). Wirtz is frequently involved in dangerous areas, as his ranking of ninth in the division for final-third passes completed will attest. His contributions have been far more geared towards ball retention and circulation rather than incision, however.

Iraola will want Liverpool to make more productive use of their high press. Most of their big chances in the league have come via corners or open-play crosses. Bradley Barcola has had moments; he recovered possession to go clean through on goal at Brentford, before pouncing on an opposition mistake to assist Alexander Isak against Brighton. But Liverpool have produced shots from only 16.7% of their ball recoveries in the final 40 yards of the pitch, which is below average (18.4%) and the seventh-worst rate in the Premier League. Improvement here will help significantly.

Big chances account for 18.1% of shots in the Premier League this season but 59.5% of the goals. They are vitally important. Liverpool’s ambitions for Iraola’s first campaign will be severely limited unless they start fashioning them far more easily.

items.titleZh: 安德鲁·比斯利：维尔茨与利物浦在密集防守面前举步维艰
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳成功限制了对手的射门机会，利物浦在密集防守前表现挣扎。
bodyZh: 根据Opta的数据，利物浦在周日以0-1不敌阿森纳的比赛中没有一次射门命中目标，这是自2003-04赛季有记录以来，他们在安菲尔德球场的英超比赛中首次出现这种情况。他们今年在酋长球场的互交白卷中也没有找到目标，尽管这两场比赛中他们都击中了门框。在记录统计异常值时，差距往往很微小。
如果亚历Alexis Mac Allister从远距离吊射进入大卫·拉亚等待双臂怀抱的球真的算作一次射门，安多尼·伊劳拉的球队会交出明显更好的进攻表现吗？更让这位西班牙人担忧的是，他的球队在阿森纳禁区内有52次触球（这很好），却只创造了一次Opta定义的绝佳机会（这很糟糕）。本赛季英超的平均效率是这个的五倍；每创造一次绝佳机会有10.3次禁区触球。
称赞阿森纳限制了利物浦机会的质量，尽管他们多次推进到球门射程内。不过大多数球队都能做到这一点。虽然有12支球队在对手禁区的触球次数少于利物浦，但本赛季只有考文垂的11次创造的绝佳机会比利物浦的12次更少。仅埃弗顿的Thierno Barry一人就有15次，而曼城的埃尔林·哈兰德也有14次，多于利物浦。
利物浦在欧洲赛场上没有这个问题。他们在仅仅三场欧冠比赛中就创造了12次绝佳机会。由于他们的两个对手拉斯克和比利亚雷亚尔被Opta评为标准低于英超任何球队，这并不令人意外。欧冠联赛阶段比赛中相对较低的风险也鼓励这些比赛变得更开放。
对于2026-27赛季的英超联赛来说，利物浦并非如此，他们花在构建低位防守上的时间比其他任何球队都多。这在某种程度上是他们自己造成的问题，因为他们在八场比赛中有五场率先失球。只有对阵伊普斯维奇和布莱顿他们才取得两球领先，这意味着对手很少有迫切需要大幅度放松防守的时候。
在利物浦的第一次新闻发布会上，主教练伊劳拉谈到了迎接深位防守带来的挑战。“我更愿意面对低位防守，因为：‘好吧，我们将控制比赛，可能我们会丢掉更少的机会，我们将在对方半场度过很多时间，这就是我们必须找到的场景，’”他说。本赛季只有四支球队在对方半场的触球次数或尝试的进攻三区传球次数多于利物浦，但这种统治地位并没有带来更高价值的机会。

这就是弗洛里安·维尔茨应该给人留下深刻印象的地方。他有能力解开最严密的后防线。然而本赛季他在联赛中没有创造一次绝佳机会。如果他在首个赛季仅有的五次在面对利物浦场内外的种种问题时还可以理解，他远远落后于多米尼克·索博斯莱（14次）、穆罕默德·萨拉赫（11次）和科迪·加克波（10次）。正如他在进攻三区完成传球次数在联赛中排名第九所证明的那样，维尔茨经常参与到危险区域中。然而，他的贡献更多是为了控球和球权流转，而不是犀利的突破。

bodyEn: Arsenal are three points clear at the top of the Premier League table. But given the team in second are Manchester City, who are likely to be facing at the very least a major points deduction, perhaps more significant is that they are five clear of Brighton in third. The season of domination that many anticipated from the champions appears to be coming to pass.

Liverpool challenged them on Sunday. There was a 20-minute spell before half-time when they swarmed all over Arsenal, and Anfield felt at least like it did in the golden years of Jürgen Klopp, when it buzzed with an energy that could overwhelm visitors. But Arsenal got through that, reset at half-time, and navigated the second half with relative comfort. For the second league game running, they denied Liverpool a shot on target.

If there is a lesson, it is that Liverpool, like Brighton, demonstrated that a very aggressive press can unsettle Arsenal. But then, a very aggressive press can unsettle anybody. In Arsenal’s loss at Brighton, Pascal Gross and Charalampos Kostoulas took difficult opportunities; at Anfield Liverpool were denied what should surely have been a penalty when Jurriën Timber tugged Alexander Isak’s shirt – another bad moment for VAR, in that the no-call essentially mandated players to go down and highlight contact. Later, Alexis Mac Allister put a free header over. That was the difference, and this Arsenal team will not give opponents many chances. They are good at closing games out. Ezri Konsa in particular was outstanding on Sunday.

They also have a strong bench. The policy has been to make the squad deeper rather than adding the very highest quality – which is why the links with Vinícius Júnior over the summer were so unexpected. That has frustrated some, but it has been successful. Arsenal on Sunday could bring on Myles Lewis-Skelly, Piero Hincapié, Viktor Gyökeres and Mikel Merino to protect their lead with very little diminution of quality. But it’s not just on a man-to-man level that Liverpool’s options suffer by comparison; their changes upset the balance. They never really had control of the game once Dominik Szoboszlai had come on for Trey Nyoni.

It’s been a recurring feature of this season that Arsenal turn half-time draws into full-time wins – it’s already happened seven times. Winning individual games, though, is only part of it; a deeper squad means there can be more rotation, which should help prevent fatigue as the season goes on, as well as providing additional cover when injuries do occur. That said, their depth was not sufficient to get them past Fleetwood in the Carabao Cup last week, although they will face few games in conditions as challenging as those on the Lancashire coast.

There are still three-quarters of the season to go, and Arsenal were in a similarly commanding position at this stage last season, four points clear of second-placed Bournemouth after nine games. The expectation then was for a procession that didn’t materialise and looked, amid a spring wobble, to have gone awry. Then as now the feeling was not merely that Arsenal were very good, but that none of their rivals looked especially threatening.

But this season they have the memory of winning the title; the insecurity of three successive second-place finishes should be lessened. There is a resilience to them that has already brought a first win at Anfield since 2012 and a victory at Nottingham Forest after successive goalless draws at the City Ground. They’re picking up points at grounds where they’ve stumbled.

Last season, City were more resilient than had been anticipated. It may be a different story this time, and not just because of the potential for a savage points deduction. After seven straight wins they have lost successive league games to Aston Villa and Brighton, but the vulnerabilities that have been exposed had been apparent earlier in the season: a high defensive line that can be exploited. Liverpool are starting to coalesce under Andoni Iraola but they haven’t clicked quite yet and are, anyway, nine points adrift. Chelsea are a point better off but still a work in progress. Brighton have probably been the best other side, but they don’t have the depth to be considered a title challenger.

Sunday made clear what was already widely suspected: Arsenal are the best team in the league by some margin. It’s not just their depth, their cohesion and the wide variety of situations from which they can score goals, it’s that they now have belief and are picking up points at places where they have often failed in the past. And if they do build up a substantial lead by Easter, that could be hugely beneficial to their European challenge, which remains the one unconquered frontier.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳具备再次夺得英超冠军的一切条件
items.summaryZh: 周日的胜利表明阿森纳阵容更深厚、更有经验，且争冠对手实力不如上赛季。
bodyZh: 阿森纳在英超积分榜上以三分优势领跑。但考虑到排在第二位的曼城可能面临重大积分扣除，或许更重要的是他们领先第三名布莱顿五分。许多人对卫冕冠军统治赛季的预期似乎正在成为现实。
利物浦在周日对他们发起了挑战。中场休息前有二十分钟的时间，利物浦对阿森纳形成围攻之势，安菲尔德球场至少恢复了尤尔根·克洛普黄金时期的氛围，那种足以压倒客队的喧嚣能量。但阿森纳顶住了压力，在半场进行了调整，相对从容地度过了下半场。这是他们连续第二场联赛让利物浦没有射正。

如果说有什么教训的话，那就是利物浦和布莱顿一样，证明了极具侵略性的高位逼抢会给阿森纳制造麻烦。但话说回来，极具侵略性的高位逼抢会给任何人制造麻烦。在阿森纳输给布莱顿的比赛中，帕斯卡尔·格罗斯和哈拉兰博斯·科斯图拉斯抓住了困难的机会；在安菲尔德，利物浦本应获得的明显点球被漏掉了，当时尤里恩·廷贝尔拉扯了亚历山大·伊萨克的球衣——这是VAR的又一个糟糕时刻，因为没有判罚本质上等同于纵容球员倒地以突出身体接触。随后，亚历西斯·麦卡利斯特将一记无人防守的头球顶高。这就是差距，而这支阿森纳球队不会给对手太多机会。他们很擅长锁定胜局。尤其是埃兹里·孔萨在周日的表现非常出色。

他们还拥有实力强劲的替补席。球队的策略一直是加深阵容深度，而不是引进最高质量的球员——这就是为什么夏天与维尼修斯的绯闻如此令人意外的原因。这让一些人感到沮丧，但它取得了成功。阿森纳在周日可以换上迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利、皮ero·因卡皮耶、维克托·哲凯赖什和米克尔·梅里诺来保护领先优势，而实力几乎没有下降。但不仅仅是人对人的比较上利物浦的选择吃亏；他们的换人打破了平衡。自从多米尼克·索博斯莱替补上场换下特雷·尼奥尼后，他们就再也没有真正掌控过比赛。
本赛季的一个经常出现的特点是阿森纳将半场平局转化为全场胜利——这种情况已经发生了七次。然而，赢得单场比赛只是其中一部分；更深厚的阵容意味着可以进行更多轮换，这应该有助于随着赛季的深入防止疲劳，并在出现伤病时提供额外的补强。话虽如此，尽管他们将面对兰开夏郡海岸那样极具挑战性的恶劣条件，但他们的阵容深度还不足以在上周的联赛杯中击败弗利特伍德。
赛季还有四分之三的路要走，而在上赛季的这个阶段，阿森纳处于类似的统治地位，在九场比赛后领先第二名伯恩茅斯四分。当时的期望是一场没有实现的游行，并且在春季的动摇中看起来已经偏离了轨道。当时和现在一样，人们的感觉不仅是阿森纳非常优秀，而且他们的竞争对手看起来都没有什么威胁。
但这个赛季他们有了赢得冠军的记忆；连续三次获得亚军的不安全感应该会减轻。他们有一种韧性，这种韧性已经带来了自2012年以来的首场安菲尔德胜利，以及在连续两次在城市球场互交白卷后客场战胜诺丁汉森林的胜利。他们正在他们曾经跌倒过的球场上全取三分。

上赛季，曼城的韧性比预期要强。这次可能会有不同的故事，不仅仅是因为潜在的严厉扣除积分。在取得七连胜之后，他们连续输给了阿斯顿联赛对手阿斯顿维拉和布莱顿，但暴露出的漏洞在赛季早些时候就已经显现：高位防线容易被利用。利物浦在安东尼·伊劳拉的带领下开始凝聚，但他们还没有完全合拍，而且无论如何，落后九分。切尔西积分多一分，但仍然是一个半成品。布莱顿可能是另一支最好的球队，但他们没有成为争冠球队的阵容深度。

周日的比赛清楚地表明了人们早已广泛怀疑的事实：阿森纳是联赛中毫无悬念的最好球队。不仅仅是他们的阵容深度、凝聚力以及能够从各种不同情况中取得进球的多样性，还在于他们现在有了信念，并且正在他们过去经常失败的地方全取三分。如果他们在复活节前建立起实质性的领先优势，那将对他们的欧洲赛场挑战大有裨益，欧战仍然是他们尚未征服的前沿。
